title: census.py read re-dates the articles of sources it did not read when another source was retrieved on the read date
goal: census.py read dates only the named sources and the articles whose every source it read, so a source retrieved the same day by other work no longer counts as read

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import kbid, kbroot, kbcommon
t = tempfile.mkdtemp()
d = os.path.join(t, "zq")
ua, ub = "https://example.org/docs/a", "https://example.org/docs/b"
sa, sb = kbid.source_id(ua, "ZQ"), kbid.source_id(ub, "ZQ")
def art(topic, sid):
    return "\n".join(["---", "topic: " + topic, "priority: P1", "applies_to: x", "retrieved_utc: 2026-01-01", "sources: [" + sid + "]", "status: complete", "---", "", "# T", "",
                      "## Summary", "- Summary line one. [DOC " + sid + "]", "", "## Facts", "- The setting is on by default. [DOC " + sid + "]", ""])
files = {"_root.md": kbroot.root_md("zq", "ZQ", "internal", "planted"), **{k: v.format(name="zq") for k, v in kbroot.FILES.items()},
         "win/a.md": art("win/a", sa), "win/b.md": art("win/b", sb)}
files["_sources.csv"] += (sa + "," + ua + ",A,Example Org,CC BY 4.0,quote,2026-01-01,,,win/a.md,\n"
                          + sb + "," + ub + ",B,Example Org,CC BY 4.0,quote,2026-06-01,,,win/b.md,\n")  # B was retrieved on the read date by other work
cols = kbcommon.STATE_COLS
files["_fetch_state.csv"] = ",".join(cols) + "\n" + "".join(",".join({"id": s, "url": u, "etag": "W/planted", "detected_utc": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}.get(c, "") for c in cols) + "\n" for s, u in ((sa, ua), (sb, ub)))
for rel, text in files.items():
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.join(d, rel)) or d, exist_ok=True)
    open(os.path.join(d, rel), "w", newline="").write(text)
env = dict(os.environ, KB_ROOTS=d)
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/census.py", "--root", "zq", "read", sa, "--note", "read the page, the one fact holds", "--date", "2026-06-01"], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
a = "retrieved_utc: 2026-06-01" in open(os.path.join(d, "win/a.md")).read()
b = "retrieved_utc: 2026-06-01" in open(os.path.join(d, "win/b.md")).read()
print("read exit", r.returncode, "; article of the read source re-dated:", a, "; article of an unread source re-dated:", b)
sys.exit(0 if r.returncode == 0 and a and not b else 1)
